sentences.text:
This application coming on for hearing this day, the court passed the following:
 ORDER 1 .
The applicant has filed this second application under Section 439 of Code o f Criminal Procedure for grant of bail.

Applicant has been arrested on 20.09.2022 by Police Station Bahodapur, District Gwalior relating to Crime No.305/2022 for the offences punishable under Sections 420, 406, 409,
465, 467, 468 and 471 of IPC.
2.
It is the submission of learned counsel for applicant that the applicant is suffering confinement since 20.09.2022 and charge-sheet has already been filed way back.
Case pertains to documentary evidence.

It is further submitted that applicant is ready to pay Rs.2,00,000/- immediately before the trial Court and Rs.2,00,000/- shall be deposited within two months from the date of release before the trial court.
He does not bear any criminal record except one case of same nature.
He undertakes to cooperate in trial.
Upon these grounds, counsel prayed for grant of bail.

sentences.text: Learned Deputy Advocate General for the State as well as counsel for complainant opposed the bail application and prayed for its rejection.

4 . Heard learned counsel for the parties at length and perused the documents appended thereto.
5.

Considering the above submissions advanced by learned counsel for the parties specially the period of custody, but without commenting on the merits of the case, this Court intends to allow this application.
Accordingly, the application is allowed.

It is hereby directed that the applicant shall be released on bail on his furnishing personal bond of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of trial Court.
8 . A copy of this order be sent to the trial Court concerned for compliance and information.
Certified Copy as per rules.

(ANAND PATHAK) JUDGE Van VANDANA VERMA 2023.08.18 18:34:05 -07'00'
